rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice when an action is carried out fairly or impartially.

example.english: The judge handled this case justly.
example.traditional: 法官公平咁處理呢宗案件。
example.jyutping: faat3 gun1 gung1 ping4 gam3 cyu2 lei5 ne1 zung1 on3 gin2

rows.note: Use this when someone makes a claim or takes a position with good reason.

example.traditional: 佢哋有理由噉反對呢個決定。
example.jyutping: keoi5 dei6 jau5 lei5 jau4 gam2 faan2 deoi3 nei1 go3 kyut3 ding6
